description: Plans a workout for the person to do: saves it in TrainRec, where their phone and watch walk them through it one set at a time, with each set's target (weight and reps, time or distance) and the rest after it. Every set starts as not yet done. Given an id and version, it changes an existing plan, even during the workout: sets already done are kept, and the phone and watch show the change within seconds. A workout that already happened is recorded with save_workout.

exercises.description: In the order performed, by exercise id (built-in or custom).

done.description: True for a set performed. False for a planned set. Default true.

elevationM.description: Metres climbed in this set (a lap, split or whole run). Feet × 0.3048.

restSeconds.description: Planned rest after this set, in seconds.

rpe.description: Rate of perceived exertion as the person reported it, 1 to 10 in half steps.

weight.description: Total load moved (on a plate-loaded or Smith machine, the sled or bar plus the plates), added load for weighted bodyweight, or assistance for assisted. In `unit`.

supersetId.description: Give exercises listed next to each other the same short label (e.g. "a") to make them a superset: the app alternates them set by set and rests only after each round.

fresh.description: true puts a workout started by mistake back to a plan: no set done, no start time. Send the whole plan.

notes.description: Shown at the top while they follow it: the goal of the session, cues.

unit.description: Unit for every weight in this call. Defaults to the person's own unit.

name: trainrec_plan_workout
title: Plan a workout to follow
